_comment: config.json — All business-specific data for this client project: branding, system prompt, services, contacts, caps. The site sells the AI agent website service itself, not Fri Soft's other products (Dish Dash, FSA_v2, web dev). Built in: Phase 1 (Fri Soft demo site). Values not given in the briefs are the string TODO: confirm.
systemPrompt: You are Fri Soft's AI assistant. Tell visitors you are an AI. Answer only using the services, pricing, hours and contact facts given to you in this config. If you are not sure, or the fact is not in this config, say so honestly and offer to connect the visitor to a person at Fri Soft. Never invent prices, timelines, promises or policies. Keep replies short, 2-4 sentences, and ask only one question at a time. When a visitor shows interest in buying, collect only their name and a phone number or email, plus a short message describing what they need — nothing more. Do not give payment, medical or legal advice. Stay focused on Fri Soft's AI agent website service and politely decline unrelated requests.
greeting: Hi, how can I help you? I'm Fri Soft's AI assistant, so I can answer questions about our service in a few seconds.

quickButtons.label: Our service
quickButtons.answer: Fri Soft builds websites with an AI agent that chats and talks with your visitors, answers questions about your business, and captures leads. We also offer an agent add-on if you'd rather keep your current website. Want pricing, or would you like to book a call?

quickButtons.label: Pricing
quickButtons.answer: Setup is a one-time fee, then a monthly plan covers hosting, usage within a fair limit, and lead reports. TODO: confirm — Fri Soft is still finalising exact numbers. Want me to connect you with the team for a quote?

quickButtons.label: Book a call
quickButtons.answer: I'd love to set that up. Could I get your name and a phone number or email so the team can call you back?

quickButtons.label: Contact
quickButtons.answer: You can reach Fri Soft by email at frisoftltd@gmail.com, in Kigali, Rwanda. TODO: confirm phone and WhatsApp numbers. Would you like to leave your details instead and have us reach out?

services.name: New website + agent
services.description: A modern one-page or small website built by Fri Soft, with the AI agent as its main feature. It replaces the client's old website.

services.name: Agent add-on
services.description: For clients who keep their current site. Fri Soft deploys a small separate agent backend, and the client adds one script tag.

services.name: Monthly plan
services.description: Hosting, agent usage within a fair limit, updates to answers and content, and lead reports.

services.name: Optional add-ons
services.description: Better voice quality, WhatsApp lead alerts, extra languages and conversation reports.

howItWorks.title: A short call
howItWorks.description: We learn what you sell, what customers ask most, and what counts as a lead for you.

howItWorks.title: You share your content
howItWorks.description: Services, prices or "contact us", hours, contacts, your logo, and ten real questions customers ask.

howItWorks.title: We build and launch
howItWorks.description: We set up your agent, test it on phone and desktop, and put it live on your domain.

howItWorks.title: We tune it with you
howItWorks.description: After two weeks we review real conversations together and improve the answers.
